response.overview: Hua Hao, a wealthy and handsome middle-aged man accustomed to a life of luxury and indulgence, unexpectedly swaps bodies with Li Chenxi, an ordinary young woman, following an accident. Trapped in her body, he is mistaken for his own mistress and thrown out of his home by his wife, while also enduring relentless teasing from his employees. As the two struggle to navigate each other's lives, their experiences with a band lead them on a journey of self-discovery. Filled with outrageous mishaps, youthful energy, and humor, this comedy celebrates personal growth and rediscovering one's true self.
response.title: Runaway Soul
